evidence.note: Systematic upfront orientation: reads root+all crate Cargo.tomls, all stubs, counts tests, then extracts contract from tests (imports catalog, ObjectMeta/TypeMeta usage, JSON key expectations, resource-type name list) and dispatches sub-agents to catalog the common::resources API — anchor-8-level test-contract extraction breadth.

Per-type derivation of exact serde field names, enum variants (KeyUsage JSON strings), and struct fields from test literals before writing each resource module — genuine test-driven signature/field-name reconstruction, not from memory.

For storage crate, mines watch/key usages and build_key/prefix assertions from tests to reconstruct the storage-key shape and Storage trait surface, then implements — probing the contract rather than guessing.

Before implementing controller-manager, systematically reads every controller test file and uses multiple sub-agents to extract per-controller specs — sustained per-crate contract extraction; dependency-respecting leaf-to-root ordering.

No tool call ever accesses /opt/k8s-reference; all K8s semantics are derived from test fixtures and memory. The reference-mining half of the dimension — explicitly present from anchor 5 upward and emphasized for the hidden conformance suite — is entirely absent.

reasoning: The agent performs exemplary, systematic reconstruction of the public API from tests, stubs, and manifests — extracting types, module paths, serde field names, and storage-key shape per crate and probing the dependency graph for leaf-to-root ordering, which matches anchor-8 rigor on the test-contract axis. However, it never once consults the mounted upstream v1.35 reference, coding K8s semantics from memory/fixtures instead of the source of truth; reference cross-checking is required even at anchor 5. This split — strong test-mining, zero reference-mining — lands the observed behavior at a 6: clearly above the crate-local minimum of 5 in breadth, but capped below 8 because half the named dimension (reference mining) is missing.
